title: Title 15 USC – Commerce and Trade (Thương mại)

versions.text:
Title 15 – Commerce and Trade.
Chapter 1: Monopolies and combinations in restraint of trade (Sherman Antitrust Act §1-7). §1: Trusts, etc., in restraint of trade illegal. §2: Monopolizing trade.
Chapter 2: Federal Trade Commission (FTC Act). §41: Federal Trade Commission established. §45: Unfair methods of competition; unfair or deceptive acts.
Chapter 2A: Securities and Trust Indentures.
Chapter 2B: Securities Exchanges.
Chapter 41: Consumer Credit Protection (Truth in Lending).
